_comments: Questing: single-phase azure-proxy validation. Emits METRIC: key=value lines for JSON summary.

image_catalog._comments: Custom Gen2 image for questing server amd64.

tests.name: phase1-azure-proxy-checks-and-shutdown
tests._comments: All checks in one phase, then shutdown.
commands: source /etc/os-release && echo UBUNTU_CODENAME=$VERSION_CODENAME && echo UBUNTU_VERSION=$VERSION_ID && echo METRIC:ubuntu_codename=$VERSION_CODENAME && echo METRIC:ubuntu_version=$VERSION_ID
dpkg -s azure-proxy-agent >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo METRIC:azure_proxy_agent_installed=1 || echo METRIC:azure_proxy_agent_installed=0
systemctl is-active azure-proxy-agent >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo METRIC:azure_proxy_agent_active=1 || echo METRIC:azure_proxy_agent_active=0
systemctl is-enabled azure-proxy-agent >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo METRIC:azure_proxy_agent_enabled=1 || echo METRIC:azure_proxy_agent_enabled=0
INHIB_BLOCK_SHUT=$(systemd-inhibit --list --mode=block | awk 'NR>1 && tolower($0) ~ /[[:space:]]shutdown[[:space:]]/ {c++} END{print c+0}'); echo METRIC:shutdown_blockers=${INHIB_BLOCK_SHUT}
INHIB_DELAY_SHUT=$(systemd-inhibit --list --mode=delay | awk 'NR>1 && tolower($0) ~ /[[:space:]]shutdown[[:space:]]/ {c++} END{print c+0}'); echo METRIC:shutdown_delayers=${INHIB_DELAY_SHUT}

policies._comments: Policy rules for single-phase questing validation.

global.name: no_failed_units
global.message: There should be no failed systemd units.

global.name: no_shutdown_inhibitors
global.message: There should be no active shutdown inhibitors.

global.name: shutdown_reached
global.message: La VM debe alcanzar PowerState stopped/deallocated tras el shutdown.

global.name: shutdown_fast_enough
global.message: El apagado debe completarse en menos de 6 minutos.
